card.name: Inside the word pharmacokinetics
card.fires_on: The piece "okin" in the misspelled-looking split of "pharmacokinetics", right after "pharmac". It appears in drug-interaction text about a drug's effect on another drug's pharmacokinetics.

modes.label: Pharmacokinetics in interaction text
modes.description: The word is split after "pharmac" and the marked piece is "okin", usually after a phrase such as "did not affect the".
modes.example: Cimetidine Cimetidine at a dose of 800 mg QD for 2 days did not affect ziprasidone pharmac<<okin>>etics.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of the word pharmacokinetics when a drug-interaction passage says one drug did or did not change another's levels.
